papers.title: AI-guided discovery of self-assembled monolayers combining synthetic accessibility and interfacial stability for perovskite solar cells
papers.summary: Navigating the vast chemical space to discover self-assembled monolayers that combine synthesizability, interfacial compatibility and long-term device stability remains a large challenge in perovskite photovoltaics. Here we present an artificial intelligence-guided design framework for self-assembled monolayers that integrates graph neural network-based retrosynthetic predictions with high-throughput screening based on density functional theory and expert chemical knowledge. Over 90,000 structures from 308 fragments were narrowed down to 300 candidates, ranked using a composite score of eight descriptors extending beyond intrinsic electronic properties to include synthesizability, hole reorganization energy λh and structural features (heteroatom content and aromaticity). The top candidate, AI-1, is readily synthesizable and incorporates favourable heteroatom functionalities. AI-1 achieves optimal energetic alignment and forms robust S–Pb coordination bonds at the buried interface, effectively suppressing non-radiative recombination and enhancing interfacial stability. Devices incorporating AI-1 achieved a power-conversion efficiency of 27.2% and retained >95% of their initial efficiency after 2,000 h of maximum-power-point tracking at 65 °C. Mechanistic studies show that the multifunctional methylthio side chain is vital, as it reinforces the interfacial bonding and balances passivation with chemical robustness. These findings demonstrate that artificial intelligence-guided design can systematically deliver self-assembled monolayers uniting high efficiency with long-term operational stability, and they provide general principles for interface engineering.

该工作针对钙钛矿发光图案化中空间分辨率与三维构型难以兼得、且发光区与非发光区化学组分相近导致选择性修饰困难的瓶颈，采用双光子激光直写于非发光钙钛矿基体内部原位诱导局域相变/组分转变，实现亚衍射极限的三维发光钙钛矿架构嵌入。

其创新在于以激光剂量调控局域卤素迁移与晶格重构，使发光区域在非发光基质中按需成核生长，机制上区别于常规光刻的逐层图案化。

所得三维发光结构特征尺寸突破衍射极限，空间选择性显著优于掩模光刻与喷墨打印。

该策略将双光子直写拓展至钙钛矿内部相工程，为三维显示与光子集成提供了可嵌入的发光微纳架构。

该工作针对可印刷碳电极介观钙钛矿太阳能电池中钙钛矿/碳界面缺陷诱导的非辐射复合与稳定性衰减瓶颈，提出以缺电子卟啉构建阴离子-π相互作用的功能化界面策略，通过卟啉大环缺电子特性与卤素阴离子间的静电/轨道协同实现对未配位Pb²⁺及卤素空位的同步钝化。

机理研究表明该相互作用调控界面能级排布并抑制离子迁移，显著降低界面复合损失。

器件效率与湿热/光照稳定性均优于对照体系。

该策略将超分子阴离子-π化学引入碳基介观器件界面工程，为无空穴传输层可印刷光伏的稳定化提供了可迁移的分子设计范式。

该工作针对钙钛矿量子点在高激发/长时间光照下光致发光衰减与表面离子迁移导致稳定性不足的瓶颈。

作者将AIEgen作为表面配位与能量传递媒介构建杂化体系，利用其刚性化限制非辐射通道并抑制配体脱附。

机理上AIEgen与量子点间的Förster/界面电荷转移协同钝化表面陷阱，实现激子限域与缺陷态密度显著降低。

所得杂化材料在连续紫外辐照下保持近单位PLQY（≈100%）且光稳定性远超常规配体交换量子点。

该策略为兼具高效率与高耐受性的钙钛矿发光体系提供了可推广的界面工程范式。
